content.short: Solana Beach is a Solana block explorer that shows core Solana statistics, validators, and token metrics.
content.description: Solana Beach is a comprehensive Solana block explorer that presents core network statistics, including validators and token metrics. The explorer enables users to browse these data across the Solana network in a clear, unified view, with quick access to validator details and token metrics. For developers, it provides testnet and devnet views and offers delegate information for the Solana Beach Validator, supporting straightforward access to delegation data within the explorer.
